headword: {中華料理|ちゅうかりょうり}

definitions.explanation: Refers to Chinese-style cooking as served in Japan. In Japanese usage, 中華料理 typically refers to higher-end, more authentic Chinese restaurant food, while 中華 alone is used more casually.

examples.japanese: {中華料理|ちゅうかりょうり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{食|た}べたい→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I want to eat Chinese food.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{辺|あた}り→辺り：01770_atari⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧{中華料理|ちゅうかりょうり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Is there a good Chinese restaurant around here?

examples.japanese: ⟦{横浜|よこはま}→横浜：28138_yokohama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中華街|ちゅうかがい}→中華街：11353_chuukagai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{本格的|ほんかくてき}→本格的：05681_honkakuteki⟧な{中華料理|ちゅうかりょうり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In Yokohama's Chinatown, there are many restaurants that serve authentic Chinese cuisine.

notes:
USAGE:
In Japan, {中華料理|ちゅうかりょうり} and {中国料理|ちゅうごくりょうり} are sometimes distinguished. {中華料理|ちゅうかりょうり} often refers to Chinese food as adapted for Japanese tastes, while {中国料理|ちゅうごくりょうり} may refer to more traditional Chinese cooking. However, this distinction is not always observed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中華料理|ちゅうかりょうり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧ (Chinese restaurant)
- {中華料理|ちゅうかりょうり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ (to cook Chinese food)
- ⟦{本格的|ほんかくてき}→本格的：05681_honkakuteki⟧な{中華料理|ちゅうかりょうり} (authentic Chinese cuisine)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{中華|ちゅうか}→中華：11322_chuuka⟧: casual, shortened form often used in everyday speech
- {中国料理|ちゅうごくりょうり}: may imply more traditional or regional Chinese cooking
